// ADD THESE LINES to your prisma/schema.prisma:
//
// In model Release { ... } add:
//   upc         String?          // Universal Product Code — auto-generated on upload
//
// In model Track { ... } add:
//   isrc        String?          // International Standard Recording Code — auto-generated on upload
//
// Full updated models for reference:

// model Release {
//   id          String       @id @default(cuid())
//   artistId    String
//   artist      Artist       @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id])
//   title       String
//   slug        String       @unique
//   releaseType String       @default("single")
//   price       Float        @default(0)
//   minPrice    Float        @default(0)
//   payWhatWant Boolean      @default(false)
//   artworkUrl  String       @default("")
//   description String       @default("")
//   credits     String       @default("")
//   releaseDate DateTime?
//   upc         String?      // ← ADD THIS
//   plays       Int          @default(0)
//   sales       Int          @default(0)
//   isActive    Boolean      @default(true)
//   tracks      Track[]
//   purchases   Purchase[]
//   createdAt   DateTime     @default(now())
// }

// model Track {
//   id           String   @id @default(cuid())
//   releaseId    String
//   release      Release  @relation(fields: [releaseId], references: [id])
//   title        String
//   trackNumber  Int
//   isrc         String?  // ← ADD THIS
//   duration     Int      @default(0)
//   previewUrl   String
//   fullUrl      String
//   waveformData Float[]
// }
//
// Then run: npx prisma migrate dev --name add_isrc_upc
// OR for production: npx prisma migrate deploy
